prompt: I sell premium single-origin coffee beans. Target: millennials who care about origin stories and sustainability. Brand name: Altitude Coffee.
assertions: Output is a single valid HTML file
Uses Tailwind CDN and GSAP CDN (no build step required)
Has an 8-column checkerboard grid layout with visible tile borders
All images use grayscale(100%) contrast(1.15) filter
Has at least 4 scroll-pinned sections with GSAP ScrollTrigger
Hero section has a non-scroll load animation
Text is scattered across individual grid tiles (one word per tile)
Accent color is NOT the default pink (#FF2D8F)
Has a grain overlay div with fixed positioning
Contact section has dark background with email form
Form uses {{FORM_ENDPOINT}} placeholder
Navigation uses mix-blend-mode: difference
Copy is uppercase manifesto-style
Page title includes Altitude Coffee
Hero ScrollTrigger has onLeaveBack callback that resets element visibility
All spatial typography words are 6 characters or fewer
Global snap uses custom snapTo function targeting pinned range centers
Snap is initialized with setTimeout (500ms delay)
Contact section footer uses mt-auto (not position absolute)
All nav anchor hrefs match section ids
Card grid buttons use margin-top:auto for consistent bottom placement
Non-pinned sections use toggleActions: play none none reverse
